name: Nicholas
title: The Proselyte from Antioch
summary: Nicholas was one of the seven men chosen to serve at the tables in the first church in Jerusalem. He was a proselyte from Antioch, meaning he was a Gentile who had converted to Judaism before becoming a Christian. He was chosen along with Stephen and five others to ensure the fair distribution of food to the widows in the church.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Servant in the Church
keyEvents.description: Nicholas was chosen as one of seven men, full of the Spirit and wisdom, to oversee the daily distribution to the widows. He was the only proselyte among the seven.

keyEvents.title: Appointed through Prayer and Laying on of Hands
keyEvents.description: The apostles prayed and laid their hands on the seven chosen servants, including Nicholas, and set them apart for service in the church.
